column3: Close to the Hebrew; “chiefs” is rendered “heads.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “My people” for “their skin.”
Close to the Hebrew; “he will not answer them” is rendered “He will not hear them.”
Close to the Hebrew; “who bite with their teeth and proclaim peace” is rendered “Who chant ‘Peace’ While they chew with their teeth,” and “they consecrate war” “prepare war.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they will cover the moustache” is rendered “they shall all cover their lips.”
Close to the Hebrew; “every straight [thing]” is rendered “all equity.”
Close to the Hebrew; “her chiefs” is rendered “Her heads,” and “for a price” “for pay.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the mountain of the house” is rendered “the mountain of the temple,” and “high places of a forest” “the bare hills of the forest.”
